name: CSO_DB_MESSAGE
description: This table contains the discussion message records.

columns.name: ACTUAL_RATING
columns.description: Actual rating for the message record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: IP_ADDRESS
columns.description: IP Address from which the request was made to create this record.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the locale record.

columns.name: MODERATE
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record neeeds moderation. Values 1 - true, 0 - false.

columns.name: OBJECT_COUNT
columns.description: This is the number of children messages.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: This is the ID used to calculate the hierarchal position of a message.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the parent message record.

columns.name: PUBLISHED
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record was published. Values 1 - Published, 0 - Unpublished.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Flag that indicates the status of the message record. Values 0-None, 1-Helpful, 2-Solved.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: This is the Title for the message record.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the topic record.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Flag that indicates the type of the message record. Values 1-Normal, 2-Announcement.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NICKNAME
columns.description: Nickname of user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that created the record.
